name: racelab-weather
description: RaceLab weather module (Tier B enrichment, B3): Open-Meteo forecast + archive adapters (no API key), hourly arrays mapped to schema WeatherObservation, gps+hour-bucket cache with TTL and stale-if-offline. All I/O injected (fetch, key-value driver, clock) — zero node built-ins, zero runtime deps, bundles into the app. Offline is a normal case, never an exception (D18 culture: the advice path never depends on this package succeeding).
